text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we work. Many companies now use automation to handle repetitive tasks, such as sorting emails or managing data. This saves time and reduces mistakes. AI-powered productivity tools also help employees plan their schedules and organise their work more efficiently. Instead of replacing people, AI often works alongside them. For example, doctors use AI to analyse test results, but humans still make the final decisions. Of course, some jobs are disappearing while new ones are appearing. This means workers need to learn new skills. In short, AI offers both opportunities and challenges in the modern workplace.
